request.description: launch: start the Simulator from the SDK and run gamePath in it. attach: debug the game an open Simulator already runs.

gamePath.description: The .pdx to run; required for launch.

sourcePath.description: Directory the .pdx was compiled from. Defaults to <worktree>/Source. When pdc compiled a copy, point this at the original; otherwise breakpoints are accepted but never hit.

sdkPath.description: Playdate SDK root for launch. Defaults to PLAYDATE_SDK_PATH from the shell environment.
